title: Multiplayer Tabs
description: Organize multiplayer servers into custom tabs for quick, clean, one-click filtering.
body:
# 🌐 Multiplayer Tabs

*Tired of scrolling through endless server lists? Sort them into tabs and find what you need in one click.*

---

## ✨ About

**Multiplayer Tabs** adds a category tab system right above your multiplayer server list. Group your servers however you like Survival, Minigames, SMPs, Friends and switch between them instantly. No more hunting through a messy, unsorted list!

Click a tab to filter, click it again to jump back to **All**. It just works.

---

## 🎯 Features

- 🏷️ **Custom category tabs** - create, rename, reorder, and delete categories on the fly
- 🔍 **One-click filtering** - tap a tab and only servers from that category are shown
- 🗂️ **Dedicated management screen** - an intuitive panel to organize everything
- 📄  **Tab navigation arrows** - browse through tabs when you have more than fit on screen
- ⚙️ **In-game config** - tweak settings via Mod Menu + Cloth Config
- 🎨 **Clean vanilla look** - active tab glows green, everything feels native

---

## 📦 Requirements

| Mod                  | Why                                             |
| -------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| **Cloth Config API** | Powers the in-game settings screen              |
| **Mod Menu**         | Lets you customize some parts of the mod        |
---
